integrity: Mathematical derivation, full source citations and standard-library checker included; independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: The exact count concerns linear idempotent weight-minus-one Lie Rota–Baxter projections on higher-rank finite-field Heisenberg algebras. The asymptotic holds for fixed field order; the three-dimensional case and the projection/subalgebra correspondence are prior. Finite computations corroborate but do not prove the theorem. Unindexed equivalent results remain a novelty risk.
title: A four-fifths rank law for idempotent Rota–Baxter projections on finite Heisenberg Lie algebras
